g.text: Terms: BMS = battery management system · ESC = electronic speed controller (drives a UAV motor) · IF = interface (a count of interfaces in block diagrams, or an IF-nnn record) · IF-nnn = interface in the item definition

(architecture/item-definition.yaml) · IF-PX4-nnn = PX4 integration interface (integrations/px4/interface-contract.md) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV ·

SUS-A1-FC = PX4-based flight controller · SUS-A1-NAV = navigation sensors, camera and telemetry · SUS-A1-PROP = motors, ESCs and propellers · SUS-A1-PWR = UAV battery and power management · SUS-GSE = ground support, maintenance supports,

charging and test equipment · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV

dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and end effectors · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal control ·

SUS-M1-PWR-BAT = battery pack, BMS and contactors · SUS-M1-PWR-DIST = protected power distribution · SUS-M1-PWR-GEN = engine-generator and governor · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK =
chassis, legs, joint actuators and stability sensing · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
